text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the veterinarians and nurses in Olympic Village for their kind, gentle, and welcoming demeanour. Multiple reviewers emphasize that doctors listen attentively to concerns and treat companion animals with genuine warmth. Staff are commended for their professionalism and willingness to go out of their way to assist clients.

Clients report that the clinic is exceptionally accommodating for nervous and reactive rescue dogs. Reviewers appreciate that the team respects an animal's personal space, adjusting examination routines so pets are not pushed beyond their comfort limits. Several owners note that their companions feel safe and genuinely enjoy visiting the hospital.

Clients frequently highlight the responsive communication from the veterinary team, appreciating considerate text check-ins after medical appointments. Reviewers note that veterinarians take time to answer detailed questions thoroughly and provide practical care advice. Pet owners feel well-informed and supported when discussing their pets' treatment options.

q.en: Is Olympic Village Veterinary Clinic suitable for reactive or nervous dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that veterinarians and staff are gentle and accommodate reactive pets by giving them space and avoiding stressful handling.
Yes, clients appreciate receiving check-in text messages after medical consultations to see how pets are recovering.

q.en: Does the clinic offer routine surgical and dental procedures?

a.en: Yes, the practice provides elective soft tissue surgeries, dental care, and preventive health checkups.

q.en: Can clients book veterinary appointments online?

a.en: Yes, online appointment requests and bookings can be made directly through the clinic's website.
